name: Flexible Dual Grid Occupancy
definition: Returns only the voxel coordinates intersected by a triangle mesh. It uses the same grid setup as mesh_to_flexible_dual_grid but stops after the occupancy stage and does not compute QEFs or dual vertices.
summary: Flexible Dual Grid Occupancy computes sparse voxel coordinates intersected by a triangle mesh, differing from O-Voxel by strictly returning occupied indices without solving QEF or computing edge intersections.
